column3: Live VCSR studies directory enumerates four records; the individually read canine lymphoma example is explicitly AI-generated/not real. The other three listings are equine allergy, a demonstration equine gastric ulcer and feline chronic kidney disease. No real therapeutic dog/cat oncology trial.

Active Iowa State clinical roster lists cerumen-based screening for canine lymphoma, which collects biomarker samples without assigning anticancer treatment; HALT is feline cardiac, and other listings do not add oncology treatment.

LSU published trials page contains lead/cadmium and atopic dermatitis in healthy dogs (excludes active malignant tumors) and osteopathy with puppy DA2P vaccine; Oncology in the site navigation is a service, not a named enrolling treatment study.

Oregon State's named canine lymphoma microbiota study observes owner-funded standard chemotherapy and collects swabs; discounted examination fees do not make it an assigned anticancer treatment trial. No other clinical entry on the current oncology roster.

Tennessee active index contains non-oncology canine and feline studies plus prospective thyroid function in dogs with thyroid carcinoma. The official thyroid flyer studies hormone measurements without assigning anticancer therapy. Historical imaging and genetics are not recruiting treatment.

Copenhagen's recruitment index and full project text agree on the current FLASH/conventional radiation option for superficial canine malignancies. Separately listed tumor-biobank and histiocytic projects collect tissues/clinical information; the detailed project list identifies hydroxyapatite as a completed ex-vivo post-euthanasia tissue project rather than canine chemotherapy access.
PetCure's official Clinical Trials section explicitly states there are no active clinical trials recruiting pets in its national network. Other links on the page are clinical service information.

Kamogawa's September 30 announcement and oncology news index name the exact company-sponsored canine anti-PD-1 antibody protocol for oral malignant melanoma. This is one confirmed Japanese multicenter protocol already in the catalog; no second Kamogawa cohort announced.

Florida neurology index enumerates Boxer glioma autogenous RNA vaccine plus non-oncologic Chiari/syringomyelia inhibitor. Individual Boxer protocol says NOW RECRUITING and details CT biopsy, RNA vaccine series, screening, covered procedures and clinic contact. Its past-tense body sentence does not negate both active headings; no new protocol.
VSEC's clinical research page lists canine chronic-enteropathy probiotic vs placebo; GI lymphoma is an explicit exclusion. No other listed oncology treatment.

Cornell's current clinical studies index contains trametinib for canine oral SCC and Smart-Start pretreatment plus CHOP for canine B-cell lymphoma. Both individual institutional pages were read and map to their own canonical IDs. Pain radiofrequency, pacemaker, IMHA, behavioral, castration, stem cells and feline CKD do not supply independent cancer treatment.

Veterinary Cancer Care Santa Fe's official trial page explicitly states no studies enrolling. Both Immunocidin entries and Canalevia are labeled past studies; prescribing Canalevia in clinical practice is not trial enrollment.

Ohio State current web master plus linked July 2026 enrollment PDF enumerate oral melanoma viral immunotherapy, anti-MIC adoptive NK for STS, and AI-guided minimally invasive bone stabilization with SBRT for appendicular OSA. Hypercoagulation, microscopic extension, infiltrative immune cells, lymph node mast cell AI and feline mammary PS-OCT are observational/diagnostic. No new therapy identified.

UF dog oncology official roster names established vaccine/chemotherapy and mRNA OSA protocols, splenic HSA vaccine, melanoma vaccine and HS trametinib. Its toceranib resistance, postoperative pain and closed Biocera-Vet cementoplasty headings do not add current anticancer access.

UF feline oncology master lists the RNA nanoparticle vaccine for oral SCC as Limited Enrollment and low-dose radiotherapy for interstitial cystitis as nononcologic. The exact oral vaccine protocol was read. The separate LSD1 cohort is paused.

Tokyo master oncology sections reconcile current canine anti-PD-1 for histiocytic sarcoma, canine/feline organoid-targeted therapy, canine bladder IDO1 and canine polymer pirarubicin; feline lapatinib ended October 31, 2026. Maeda's directly linked page confirms the canine urogenital Nexavar study reached target and ended December 1, 2021. No fifth new intake.

Hokkaido official research page has one current dog cancer therapeutic cohort, anti-PD-L1 for lung-metastatic oral melanoma and malignant tumors subject to study review. Its feline OA screening and grant entries including feline AML cell culture and oncology publication results are not current treatment cohorts.

Complete Missouri master lists BI705564 newly diagnosed B-cell lymphoma, feline GI WART+COP/doxo, pulmonary carcinoma gilvetmab and LEAH CD20 CAR-T. The COTC033 master paragraph conflicts with exact AVMA Completed; canonical already inactive. Thyroid NIS does not itself deliver anticancer treatment. The prior carboplatin timing cohort is absent and retained inactive under owner decision.

Tufts official list maps primary-lung SBRT, SABR for lung metastases, actionable OSA, Z-007, FAP CAR-T, metastatic OSA vaccine/TME and HSA liquid-biopsy-directed treatment to their exact records. BG34 melanoma is suspended; COTC034 only characterizes osteosarcoma. Feline abdominal WART for inflammatory enteropathy is not cancer.

Veterinary Cancer Society lists AVMA, NCI, CSU Flint, ACI, PetCure, Santa Fe Veterinary Cancer Care, VOS and VSSO. The source itself is a pointer list; AVMA and universities have their own rows, PetCure/Santa Fe confirmed no open studies and VOS/VSSO have separate dispositions.

Purdue primary links confirm H-FIRE with liver resection, HIFU before CHOP and HIFU before amputation/carboplatin, and cPD-L1 plus vinblastine/deracoxib for InvUC. M029 actively recruits but remains nonmatchable Phase I. Specific PD-L1 vaccine footer says Enrollment Closed, overriding general recruiting heading. COTC034 characterization paused, diagnostic imaging is not treatment, and CDK9 remains completed.

Current UQ VETS recruitment page names dog bone cancer vaccine for recently diagnosed appendicular OSA, linked to university screening. It matches the UQ school listing; other recruitment is not companion-animal oncology.

JVCS directory has two 2026-06-22 records; the organoid-guided solid-tumor cohort and IDO1 epacadostat cohort both map to exact currently described University of Tokyo organizer protocols. Forms are study submission guidance, not patient enrollment.

NVLU master lists exactly one therapeutic cancer protocol: canine individualized survivin peptide vaccination. Individual clinical research page specifies that intervention. Feline HCM and canine dry-eye cell trial are not oncology.

Illinois current oncology master and eight individual PDF notices match daunomustine lymphoma, IL12/IL15 melanoma, current JEN-101+RT/amputation OSA, current Z-007 lung metastases, SBRT/hydrogel OSA, two separate STS protocols, and gilvetmab/epacadostat UCC. MRI glioma is imaging research, the two legacy OSA aliases remain superseded.

Dongjun official recruiting announcement lists separately recurrent/unresected canine MCT, non-amputated or metastatic OSA, and oral SCC; exact organizer and defined cohorts match all three canonical IDs. Study drug and specified assessments covered; candidate thresholds and exact professional screening preserved.

Oniris current official page names exact multicenter BIOCERA-VET appendicular OSA cement injection. Its stated purpose is stabilization and pain relief; known supportive record stays outside treatment matching. UF's separate SBRT-plus-cement study closed and is not merged.

Mars network native JSON returns all 12 studies; the only oncology treatment is HIFU for canine lymphoma registry object 28770/140763 at VCA Dallas, mapped to existing HIFU then doxorubicin protocol. Biobank and the other ten entries are not anticancer treatment. BluePearl crosslink Paccal is closed in AVMA and remains excluded.

Kode's current Kv9 pilot and linked referral/FAQ describe accessible solid tumors <5 cm, pathology, medication exceptions, at least two appointments, provider coverage of trial treatment/monitoring and owner-paid diagnosis. Same existing Kv9 protocol; no second trial or date beyond current official referral language.

Virginia Tech lists LASEIT PDT for liver tumors, histotripsy for thyroid, verteporfin PDT for brain tumors and CED cytotoxin for glioma. Direct OSA histotripsy document says treatment arm completed and only standard-care controls recruit; the independent amputation/chemotherapy monitor is not novel therapy. Equine melanoma and benign lipomas are outside scope.

University of Milan's official owner protocol is the known OncoFAP-MMAE targeted treatment for advanced, spontaneous PAF-positive canine cancer without appropriate standard therapy. It details FAP pathology, team screening, radiographic assessment and experimental treatment. No second trial on this page.

SASH current research overview describes no-harm research and examples of cystitis, hydration, thyroid, renal and surgical research. It does not identify an independently recruiting oncology treatment study.
The Cancer Vet official trial page offers case discussion and generic potential study benefits, with no protocol ID, intervention, site or recruiting eligibility in the public document.

Cornell COOL official research page contains one explicitly active intervention, same Peralta canine oral SCC trametinib protocol, daily drug and planned evaluation through day 126, funded study procedures and conditional $1,000 credit. Hospital diagnoses wording and lab's strong-suspicion screening are distinct; preserve conservative rule.

Today’s same-URL Web fallback at lines 48–52 enumerates exactly CHOP vs LOPP, CMP002 STING dose escalation, quasiorganelle for histiocytic sarcoma, neoadjuvant steroid timing in MCT and metastatic feline mammary chemotherapy. Exact individual Web routes were read separately; catalog has all five and CMP002 stays watchlist. No sixth listing.

Oncology, surgery and hospital study rosters reconcile Lattice, meningioma RT, high-grade glioma chemoradiation, feline oral SCC FLASH, STS and plexus surgical guidance; oral vinorelbine is safety/dose finding and already excluded. Separately read October feline ADAM-12 vaccine ZH226/2024: Phase 0 safety-first, watchlist only. Heart-base and pituitary/adrenal studies monitor dogs receiving separately arranged RT; PET/CT is diagnostic.

Official UQ School and UQ VETS current clinical lists agree on the postoperative canine appendicular OSA vaccine. The two Enzistat cohorts are confirmed research protocols from 6 February but current intake is not listed or independently confirmed, so both remain watchlist.

WCVM veterinary research-request list has a current feline FIP coagulation study and no named cancer treatment invitation. The reachable page is a request index, not proof of a broader institutional oncology roster.

Ardent and its developer Unleash identify the same K9-ACV with CD200AR-L versus carboplatin after canine OSA amputation. Unleash says recruitment complete and exact current AVMA VCT25005864/20869 says Completed. The third route yields only an empty JS shell in Work and Web. No separate current cohort offered.

Official Web fallback lines 23–25 list exactly the current feline oral SCC notice. Its separately retrieved protocol specifies five days of RT with Lavurchin and 1/3/6 month rechecks; it maps to the existing single Gifu trial.

SNU hospital clinical recruitment master explicitly dates the canine/feline oncology radiotherapy pilot through 13 December 2024. Targeted Korean check found no specific newer invitation or extension. General radiotherapy service does not create enrollment.

ACI’s open-studies roster and exact oral melanoma page both explicitly show Enrollment has now closed. The named CKD, chronic enteropathy, epilepsy and TPLO items do not treat cancer. No active oncology treatment offered by this roster.

The University of Bologna current clinical oncology roster expressly marks each of the three published protocols CONCLUSO: appendicular canine osteosarcoma, malignant canine melanoma and visceral/cardiac hemangiosarcoma. No open study listed.

ELIAS official current program names two canine osteosarcoma cohorts and explicitly says enrollment closed for each. The separate ECIP-OSA-01 novel-adjuvant/surgery primary confirms closed. The combined-chemotherapy detail route is held; the sponsor’s full public list already expressly states its status.

CICV current public hub names chronic digestive symptoms in dogs, chronic feline constipation, and oral malignant tumor protocol. Exact FINDIMMUNE protocol describes 10 visits at VetAgro Sup for intratumoral therapy for canine oral melanoma or oral SCC; maps to exact existing trial. Digestive projects are not oncology.

The ANZCVS chapter official news view returned “There are no news at this time” and a waiting UI; no Science Week abstract or independent treatment protocol is exposed. The current chapter news is not a recruiting roster.

The sponsor archive reports separate canine and feline Paccal enrollment completion and later results. Cantrixil reports are PK/toxicology. The historic owner-facing Paccal listing does not establish reopening.

Hayburn’s investigator profile includes a single exact whole-abdomen RT study for feline small-cell gastrointestinal lymphoma, tagged Active - Recruiting. Its exact direct participant route and same-URL Web fallback were insufficient; existing current Texas A&M record is unchanged.
JSAMC’s public iCAT link describes basic and translational research and directs users to the exact protected JSAMC clinical-trials page; it does not publish a replacement cohort roster.

Estima’s COE page is a clinical service/research overview; Portuguese text describes cooperation with developers and safe clinical studies but publishes no intervention, protocol number or patient enrollment terms. Do not add a care directory.

Perseus displays a Fall 2020 trial-watch announcement and referral links to university/hospital clinical programs. No independently named intervention or fresh roster is published; known university sources are separately accounted for.

CureLab publishes outcomes of Elenagen pilots and a general invitation in multiple countries. It gives no named current cohort, exact clinical site, current eligibility or cost; broad contact invitation is not a confirmed treatment route.

Dog Cancer Foundation’s directory links AVMA, NCI, PetCure, CSU, Santa Fe, ACI and other master programs; it does not independently offer treatment. PetCure and Santa Fe explicitly list none; ACI melanoma exact page says closed.

Benno’s pipeline reports BTX001 bladder and HSA outcome publications and an ongoing OSA amputation/vaccine study. The latter gives no recruiting site, current patient invitation or owner terms. Outcome evidence alone does not create access.

VSSO current research list requests surgical outcome data: amputation infection risk (June 2026), MCT lymphadenectomy retrospective outcomes, oral melanoma nodal removal outcomes and intramuscular HSA management. No assigned treatment opportunity on the registry page.

ValiRx current pipeline charts separate OSA, HSA, lymphoma and leukemia development, and news describes canine oncology and company plans. No named recruiting drug/site/patient protocol or product access is published.

ACTREC scientist’s official profile lists spontaneous disease research, publications and translational preclinical imaging facility. The “New Recruitments” item is institutional staffing/navigation and no companion animal cancer treatment enrollment is described.

UPM comparative oncology describes assays, natural/synthetic compounds, animal cancer biology, and preclinical work. Its separate MoU route is under exact access hold; the unrestricted program has no owner-facing named cohort.

VMD home, trials and Managed Access each explain generic CRO/logistics and regulatory access services. None identifies a named recruiting pet oncology intervention or a verifiable specific treatment access program.
Aúna oncology trial explainer discusses referral, risks and funding variability but lists no named ongoing therapy and no linked individual study on the configured page.
VMDP uses 募集中 to invite new graduates and describes drug development throughput. The exact page does not announce patient enrollment or a specific trial.

IVRI October walk-in is a temporary research-job announcement; its canine mammary therapy project is research scope, not an owner trial. The exact project list contains mammary biomarker studies and publications, not clinical enrollment.

AACF research reports completed feline oral SCC RT, canine STS RT publication, HSA proteomics, and prior osteosarcoma antimetastatic study. Its research support and equipment descriptions are not current recruitment.
PetTrialFinder advertises a study-finding and application service with claims of 100+ trials, but public page exposes no study roster or individual primary protocol; intake form not submitted.

CimCure reports human clinical phase and canine HSA vaccine+doxorubicin results, and explains iBoost technology and rollout. No current new canine patient pathway; Benno companion animal development is separately recorded.

SAACA foundation homepage and partner list describe funding, education and support for Onderstepoort oncology. No named oncology drug protocol or enrollment route; non-veterinary partners listed are fundraising supporters.

iCAT pages describe translational PD-1, diagnostics and investigator work at JSAMC. Their current-trial link is precisely the JSAMC held route; no separate current cohort roster or matching site list is published by iCAT.

Immuvera company/finance/partnership pages describe inhaled Nebumet development for lung disease in veterinary oncology; financing and OMICA combination research are not confirmed site intake. Existing country-specific watch records remain inactive.

SAGE master names two PetCure radiation and two ImpriMed items. Current PetCure national source explicitly has no active trials. Direct ImpriMed canine MCT sample-sensitivity study is on hold, and feline linked Immunoprofile is diagnostic/prognostic lab service, not assigned therapy. No current SAGE enrollment confirmed.

The BVSC foundation lists five research links. Direct pages confirm completed QBiotics tigilanol STS, completed diagnostic PET/CT OSA, general half-body irradiation information, SCC skin-bacteria research, and an early target-protein project for prostate cancer. None provides a current named treatment intake.

Exact Paccal owner page lists canine postsplenectomy HSA and feline solid tumor dose finding, both explicitly RECRUITMENT COMPLETED. Developer archive independently dates both closures and publishes outcomes. The former funding/therapy description is not current enrollment.

BARC trial body names current gold nanoparticle NIR, intratumoral carboplatin for SCC, and local EGFR/HER2 vaccine. The two former Paccal cohorts, Gilvetmab+EGFR HSA and naive/refractory B-cell lymphoma are explicitly closed; TLR 7/8/9 and Palladia/FMT remain labelled coming soon. AT-014 and Immunocidin are legacy navigation labels with no active cohort body; do not activate from anchors.

CanineCancer Australia’s legacy Auranofin invitation uses a copyright-2013 overview. The trial institution describes Auranofin as previous OSA research; current UQ separate vaccine trial is not the same drug.

MediPaws lists surgery and renal-safety studies and one splenic HSA vaccine plus doxorubicin link, which maps to University of Melbourne AEC project 35274 at Sydney. Direct study URL is subject to exact saved access restriction; an index does not refresh complete enrollment/site or cost evidence.

Edinburgh’s published 2 September 2024 Clinical Trials Programme is an institutional explanation plus contact/FAQ, not a clinical roster. The separately listed RVC canine insulinoma protocol still has its own exact restrictions and unresolved site intake.

Current AMC clinical roster lists artificial neobladder and feline CKD. The former specific cancer page has no fresh recruitment confirmation, splenic HSA is absent, and separately read resiniferatoxin is a lower urinary tract symptom/pain pilot. Neither historical therapy record has sufficient current enrollment evidence.

Official animal product section describes approved Vaxleukin-15 use, including already catalogued canine adjunct indications. Dated Nov 9 news is next-generation CAR platform research, not pet protocol enrollment. Mammary development, product access and feline extrapolation are not combined.

The TCC directory has stale or secondary links. Purdue exact CDK9 and single-agent cPD-L1 Completed; triple combination active. NC State IL-12 30 September end and Probiome inactive per independent route. Yale vaccine maps to same Therajan EGFR/HER2, not separate slots. AMC symptom trial is supportive; Santa Fe Immunocidin past. Old CSU NIH972 individual URL returns 404; unverified Minnesota and Wisconsin do not prove new slots.

MedVet clinical master names exactly one active oncology protocol, same Therajan EGFR/HER2. Salt Lake enrolls; Cincinnati and Cleveland restricted to established patients, Pittsburgh to PA dogs; Chicago paused. This checks the entire MedVet site subset; non-MedVet partner branches are reconciled separately. Dry eye and CIE are not oncology.

Ontario current canine and feline oncology rosters reconcile exact MRI-guided distal-radius OSA HIFU, oral melanoma Palladia and feline oral SCC Porphysome PDT. The separate canine oral Porphysome is explicitly On Hold; blood recurrence test, phone imaging, T-cell outcome study, biobank and thyroid staining do not assign oncology treatment.

Official recruiting menu and all four named current Nihon primary pages match existing proteasome inhibitor for canine/feline B-cell tumors, mutation-positive canine lung cancer, head/neck alternating magnetic field for small/medium dogs, and canine glioma collagen-targeted IL-12. The fifth item is canine cognitive dysfunction. Research grant years are not an exact enrollment end.

Vetigenics exact sponsor pipeline explicitly says both oral melanoma VGS-001 sites closed, both urothelial VGS-002 sites closed, and CHECKMATE-K9 fully enrolled with each five listed branches closed. No other named trial is offered. VGS-002 matches already archived AVMA VCT23005729.

VCCS official clinical trial section explicitly names Yale-developed Therajan peptide vaccine. Oncologist referral with full records or optional $495 screening consult; visits $995 each and required tests owner-paid, vaccine free. Confirmed VCCS site and existing one multicentre catalog identity; no separate consultation service added.

Anivive master identifies one anticancer cohort, existing verdinexor plus carboplatin for canine osteosarcoma, marked Recruiting. Other entries are cardiomyopathy, infectious diagnostics and bronchitis. Exact study route is held; two old sponsor domain URLs fail in Work and Web.

Yamaguchi current VMC roster includes exact anti-CD20 for lymphoid tumors, an old broad PD-1 programme, blood-based early diagnosis and completed reovirus. Current 30 September official program opens an exact corporate oral melanoma PD-1 cohort across three sites, separate from any broad program.

EVVIVAX clinical roster lists AAHSD000080 Tel-eVax, 81 canine OSA Erb-eVax, 82 feline mammary Erb-eVax, 85 canine TCC Erb-eVax. These map to four existing Pisa contactable watch records; none publishes confirmed current intake or newer eligibility, timing or costs.

Oklahoma State three exact clinical-trials routes failed to provide a readable recruiting roster in Work and Web. Targeted university search located a nanomedicine lab and no official pet oncology clinical protocol; Ohio State results are a different institution.

Veterinary Oncology Services listed public site supplied no usable intake in Work/Web. AVMA exact objects describe several ECT and immunotherapy interventions, but current patient clinics and cohort identity are not verified. ECT treatment-service directories are excluded.

LMU exact canine OSA nerve-block study assigns pain management only. The title for Palladia effect on thyroid function links to a page that repeats the same OSA nerve-block content rather than publishing a Palladia protocol; no treatment opportunity inferred.

Mizuno’s current lab index separately labels broad PD-1 and CD20 continuing as of 2024, and reovirus ended. Current VMC anti-CD20 and the September 2026 corporate melanoma PD-1 were compared to the lab material; the older broad PD-1 status and scope remain unconfirmed.

The Kids describes historical Perth sarcoma surgery plus wound-bed immunotherapy gel. Exact UWA collaborator Phase I project lists Finished and 14 March 2022–14 March 2023. Separate current development page has collaborator context but no recruiting successor.

Familiar program and exact FAM-010 remain Enrolling Soon at Illinois, matching the explicit owner-approved listing with inquiry form. FAM-003 and remaining pipeline descriptions offer no current named patient protocol. Six visits over 3.5 months and first dose within 21 days of splenectomy are individual scheduling, not study cutoff.

Protect’s exact PT001 Phase field trial announcement publishes stage II–III oral melanoma, canine age ≥1 year, randomized PD-L1/CTLA-4 vaccine and eight named sites. Notice is October 26, 2025; no new site-specific enrollment update or cutoff found today.

Evergreen Taipei official September 3, 2025 announcement matches the existing canine melanoma/OSA IL-15 cohort: subcutaneous or inhaled for pulmonary metastases, weekly ×8, medication free and ancillary tests/support paid. No recruitment end, newer cohort notice or additional site verified today.

Vienna’s source PDF describes a true historical feline GI lymphoma surgery plus chemo/RT study but its own file date is 2016. The 2020 institutional magazine describes clinical radiotherapy, not contemporary trial intake.

ESVONC is explicitly a non-exhaustive Europe research pointer. Each canine/feline intervention cross-reconciled against Oncowaf or exact organizer, with unresolved Italy vaccine, Frégis, Portugal, sinonasal RT and insulinoma retained individually. New Zurich ADAM-12 Phase 0 excluded from therapeutic matching.

Oncowaf detailed list reconciled individually with exact current organizer records for known therapies, nontherapeutic biomarker/diagnostic items, and unconfirmed site/recruitment facts. The directories alone cannot reopen the Italian vaccine, Frégis, Portugal, RVC or Utrecht owner holds.

Current AVMA native 856 and 56 recruiting oncology objects individually reconciled. 39 exact canonical, 7 non-treatment, 3 expired despite roster label, and 7 external or clinical identity gaps. All ten formerly pending individual AVMA routes are now read in rendered Browser. Dallas and Fort Worth have separate dates/locations and clinic roles; Fort Worth arm conflict unresolved, CIGAT exact branch identity unresolved, and five Impellizeri records lack named confirmed intake and/or have conflicting criteria.

CASTR sponsor home lists Feasibility and dose-optimization local T-cell engager and links exact August 4 article. Its main aim is safety/feasibility. Current named registry identity was separately reconciled; VRCCO-only owner policy, with WSU intake not confirmed. Sponsor testimonials and conference publications do not reopen Paccal.

Browser-rendered PetTrials shows all 7 cards. Only two oncology pointers: current UQ postoperative OSA vaccine already catalogued, and Murdoch checkpoint combination Coming Soon (anticipated 2026, exact dates and enrollment TBC). Other five are not oncology.

CCA research page lists EGFR/HER2 known protocol, microbiome/fasting, historic B7-H3 CAR-T invitation, Immunocidin and IL-12 collaboration. B7-H3 link is old Illinois PDF; current Illinois roster lacks that exact enrollment. Santa Fe says no current trials; exact known sponsor rows for other therapies independently considered.

Alfort hospital innovative-treatment section describes the historic CANC_2019_1 TG6002 canine oncolytic study. Targeted French route check returned historical study and no explicit current enrollment or extension. Other innovative services are outside trial scope.

Ghent current list includes one exact therapy GCN2-IN-6 with mastectomy, independently verified from owner/vet pages. Doxorubicin cardiac screening observes standard treatment. FLT imaging during separately scheduled surgery and head/neck imaging remain nonmatchable pending exact assigned-therapy interpretation.

DVG current registry is a pointer to Zurich trials plus diagnostics. Glioma chemoradiation, feline oral FLASH and two fluorescence surgery protocols matched directly. Its feline injection-site vaccine links to Zurich Phase 0/watchlist context; PET, sentinel nodes and histiocytic blood screening not treatment. One obsolete Zurich surgical URL is insufficient in Work and Web; exact individual current alternatives were read.

Akston current pipeline and newsroom describe product development, with exact Oct 29, 2025 Purdue Ambifect PD-L1 safety/tolerability solid-tumor launch. Current exact Purdue protocol explicitly says Enrollment Closed; separate antibody combination continues at Purdue. No new live Akston study in the current news.

Metropolitan master lists SOLID at Akron/Cleveland and PUSH at Akron; cardiac CARE, feline LSA diagnostic cfDNA, sample collection and WINK dry eye are excluded. Exact sample PDF was read. SOLID coordinating page is held; PUSH cohort/site discrepancy still recorded with current CASE and First Coast evidence.

MIB Agents is an educational canine OSA pointer source. Its linked CSU dual-energy CT is an observational bone-strength study around already selected SBRT, as independently established in the CSU native roster. No own ongoing treatment cohort.

The configured UKRI project URL and redirect both return the generic Gateway to Research project index/API notice with unrelated 2028 grants. Targeted Antigenesis study search found no exact current canine owner-facing protocol.

ANZCVS dedicated oncology clinical-trial news path returned insufficient content in Work and Web; document library is protected by exact restriction. Open general chapter feed reports no news, and is not independent current trial roster.

SLU Silver Bullet 2.0 current grant proposes OXC-101/karonudib for canine lymphoma, HSA and mammary tumors, Sept 2026–Aug 2030; PI page describes work, Brazil FAPESP grant documents separate scientific context. Neither grant confirms owner intake, complete sites, criteria or costs.

Dog Oncology Group home and 2024 CVE PDF describe CANCV autologous cancer vaccine approach. No defined new prospective owner trial with diagnosis criteria, active center roster, dates or cost is published on these routes.

Two exact April 2021 UCM mammary trial invitations remain historical. New targeted search found separate official May 2025 immunotherapy invitation for poor-prognosis mammary cancer in dogs/cats with no exact investigational product, present intake confirmation or cutoff.

Exact 2023 FiDo owner flyer route now redirects to Adelaide general College of Health page, including human-study overview. Targeted Australian search found the old flyer index only and no named current companion-animal mammary protocol.
The exact Calusa/UConn social signal URL returned insufficient text through Work and Web. Targeted Calusa/UConn current dog treatment search did not yield a site, agent or patient protocol.

UFPel exact documents describe two separate prospective projects: randomized bleomycin ECT versus calcium for up to 3cm canine cutaneous neoplasia (through Feb 28, 2027) and routine canine eyelid tumor incision vs cryosurgery (through Mar 12, 2028). Neither publishes current recruitment dates, owner costs or a specific participant invitation.

Hifas current products and R&D pages describe mushroom-derived complementary feed, a feline case after separate ECT, atopy research, and R&D/marketing material. Exact PDF reports experimental data, not a published owner-recruiting oncology intervention.

SGGW exact lab URL redirected to general Faculty recruitment/education, and archived Institute page lists academic research without a named patient oncology trial. Polish exact search did not establish a current nanooncology treatment protocol.

Current Work profile shows professional contact/header but not the full previous DOG-FIGhT detail. Permitted Web official profile evidence still describes ferumoxytol and subsequent RT and no more exact site/eligibility/funding/cutoff. Preserve exact existing Liverpool record and verification date.

Official current site includes a full Bellingham Aurelius/Lytix pilot recruitment dialog recovered in same-URL Web. One defined oncolytic peptide plus immune therapy cohort, distinct from general ACT service. Prior site body did not expose the dialog on Work. Published funding, untreated stage 3–5(a), visits and Theresa Westfall checked.

Current oncology roster lists XCSgel STS, PIVOT-C, invasive bladder IL12, liver and mammary INSPIRE. Equine melanoma/SCC, chronic gingivostomatitis and tissue donation excluded. Direct dated IL12 intake ended 2026-09-30; older feline ethanol AVMA record finished 2020. Retain distinct known treatment cohorts and hold source-wide sufficiency because of the current roster versus exact expired bladder protocol and exact primary restrictions.

LEAH sponsor advertises Minnesota, Missouri and Ohio as partners. Minnesota exact institutional study explicitly Open and enrolling, ≥10kg except boxers and high-grade peripheral substage A. Missouri exact distinct local criteria >10kg and the separate current funding. Ohio official listing shows no exact LEAH clinical section; sponsor language cannot confirm a currently open Ohio slot.

TheraJan owner, veterinarian and FAQ paths plus official 12 USDA-approved locations describe the EGFR/HER2 peptide product. Sponsor Canine Cancer Alliance listing independently distinguishes nine currently reported, three paused and leads in Boulder and Santa Fe; Santa Fe says no current trials. Current branch intake beyond confirmed sites cannot be derived from approval.

Maeda current official home still links to Tokyo trials, and September 1 sorafenib is a publication signal. Exact Tokyo poster route Work unreadable; Web identified one-page PDF without extracted text, screenshot did not return a readable image. Independent primary retrospective project material cannot establish current TCC sorafenib enrollment.

Current JASMINE Japanese provider referral page lists canine nasal adenocarcinoma innovative radiation research (Azabu/Nihon) and JVCOG Tokyo DLBCL referral paused. Institution-level targeted follow-up did not yield an individual protocol defining the nasal therapy or patient terms.

CSU official native gallery enumerates 37 studies and Flint current list 10 cards. Reconciled two separate CAR-T protocols (IACUC 5269 STS only; IACUC 3398 post-resection limb OSA and lung-only metastasis), current new IACUC 8528 feline low-dose RT, distinct verdinexor-only 6276 vs glioma CAR-T plus verdinexor, lapatinib/RT bladder, feline oral immunotherapy, 3D limb sparing, AML trametinib and single-fraction TVT. Sentinel-node mapping, BARC, bone-density CT and intraoperative ICG imaging do not establish separate anticancer treatment. Carboplatin-pain remains held; older nonsurgical brain umbrella does not create a duplicate.

UC Davis current native gallery lists 38 studies. Mapped CARE and PRISM brain, CAALM, FAP CAR-T, nasal TAE and separate nasal RT/IA chemo, current liver VCCT-22-005 TAE/TACE cards, and oral PDL1 image-guided treatment pathway. Urethral stent is supportive; prostate embolization card has expired 2019 recruitment and sampling only; pituitary 24957 is surgical but no malignant endocrine tumor eligibility; cutaneous lymphoma and bone cancer characterization are not treatments. Separate Completed AVMA VCT26005956 remains not proved to cover either currently native-listed 21290/24645 arm.

Directory three live pages returned 293 unique objects; 94 oncology and near-scope entries were adjudicated in an exact ID crosswalk. Current independent organizer status controls. Notably Penn metastatic and NCSU IL12 passed cutoffs, CSU pain carboplatin held, and CIGAT HSA directory object Completed was last seen in September without permitted current primary.
